title: Part 7
content_zh: When the family is regulated, the state is ordered. When the state is ordered, there is peace throughout the world. This is the chain, the great chain of cultivation that links the smallest personal effort to the greatest universal harmony.
content_en: When the family is regulated, the state is ordered. When the state is ordered, there is peace throughout the world. This is the chain, the great chain of cultivation that links the smallest personal effort to the greatest universal harmony.
